usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 on 30 October 2026, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE), Consumer Price Index September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI 4.9% year on year in September 2026 (HICP 5.0%), released 14 October 2026; INE's flash estimate for October 2026 is also 4.9% (Trading Economics). World Bank 2025 average 2.7%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; Spanish HICP 2021-2025 average 4.1% (ECB ICP); CPI 4.9% in September 2026
inflation_projection.note: Spain shares the ECB's 2% target; with inflation now well above it and a 4.1% five-year average, 2.5% is used for long-run planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Spain uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate raised from 2.25% to 2.50% with effect from 16 September 2026 (main refinancing rate 2.65%).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Spanish banks, household overnight deposits (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average 0.16% on household overnight deposits (current and most savings accounts) in September 2026, the same as in August.

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/Banco de España MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (2.29% in September 2026); no separate 3-month rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Spanish banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year (2.01% in August, 2.29% in September 2026); deposits of 1-2 years paid 1.91% in September 2026.

dps_rate.note: Spanish banks have no standard monthly recurring deposit; long-term savings accounts (CIALP) accept regular payments, but no official average rate for them was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Spanish banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits in September 2026; overnight deposits pay 0.16%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Spain has no savings bond reserved for individuals; individuals buy the ordinary Letras, Bonos and Obligaciones directly from the Treasury (Tesoro Público), recorded under the bill and bond rows.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Tesoro Público, latest auction results: Letras del Tesoro
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month Letras auctioned on 13 October 2026 at an average 2.635% (marginal 2.645%); 12-month Letras 2.999% on 6 October 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Tesoro Público, latest auction results: Bonos del Estado
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year bond (coupon 2.60%, maturing 31 May 2031) auctioned on 15 October 2026 at an average 3.482%; Trading Economics showed 3.45% on 30 October 2026.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Tesoro Público, latest auction results: Obligaciones del Estado
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year bond (coupon 3.40%, maturing 31 October 2036) auctioned on 1 October 2026 at an average 4.176%; the market yield had eased to 3.95% by 30 October 2026 (Trading Economics).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Spain taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest is savings income taxed at 19% on the first EUR 6,000, 21% to EUR 50,000, 23% to EUR 200,000, 27% to EUR 300,000 and 30% above; banks withhold 19% on deposit interest (withholding not stated on the page read).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail-only government savings bond exists; returns on Letras del Tesoro are savings income taxed at 19-28% with no withholding, per Tesoro Público (tesoro.es, Tributación de las Letras del Tesoro).

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos de Entidades de Crédito (FGD), frequently asked questions
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per institution; some deposits linked to property sales and life events are covered in full for a limited time.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Spanish banks, extended credit card credit to households (new business)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Average 18.27% on extended credit card credit in September 2026; Spain has no fixed legal cap (courts apply the usury law case by case).

equity_return_low.sourceName: IBEX 35 18,653 on 30 Oct 2026, up 16% in a year (Trading Economics)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Spanish shares only slightly beat after-tax Treasury bills over a long spell.

equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.5 points over the after-tax safe rate, within the 4-point limit, for a diversified equity fund in euros.

equity_return_high.sourceName: IBEX 35 (Trading Economics); long-run global equity returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified equity fund repeating long-run global equity returns in euro terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps its value after the 2025-26 spike while the euro holds steady against the dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises a little faster than world inflation and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.29% less 19% tax = 1.9% (ECB MFI statistics, September 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank term deposits after tax if ECB rates fall.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 3-month Letras 2.635% and 12-month Letras 3.0% less 19% tax = 2.1-2.4% (Tesoro Público)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: rolling Treasury bills and term deposits after tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding long government bonds after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The DGSFP publishes insurance market statistics but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover (seguro de vida riesgo) is widely sold, but no regulator or official premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover was found; insurer quotes cannot be used.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care is free under the National Health System; no official figure for a typical out-of-pocket private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance in Spain is sold at flat premiums per person, not per sum insured; no premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

oop_health_share.note: 2023 is the latest year published (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Spain, health: 2.2% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have risen close to headline inflation; 3% (a little above the planning rate) is used for private medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Spain, education: 2.6% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Public education is free; paid education rose 2.6% in 2025, so 3% is used for planning.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 81.4, women 86.7 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 83.9.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 32.9 (2025, World Bank), 53.9 (2040) and 66.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/spain/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: From 2027 the ordinary age is 67, or 65 with at least 38 years 6 months of contributions (in 2026: 66 years 10 months, or 65 with 38 years 3 months). Same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Estatuto Básico del Empleado Público, article 67.3-67.4 (BOE consolidated text)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants in the general Social Security scheme (everyone appointed since 1 January 2011) are compulsorily retired at that scheme's ordinary age, 67 from 2027 (art. 67.4); those still in the older civil-servant scheme (Clases Pasivas) retire at 65 and may ask to stay until 70 (art. 67.3).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.29% less 19% tax = 1.9% (ECB MFI statistics, September 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: term deposits after tax if ECB rates fall.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case set at the after-tax 3-month Treasury bill rate, below the 12-month bill's 2.4% after tax.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of government bonds held to maturity, below the current after-tax 10-year yield.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Letras 2.1-2.4% after tax; IBEX 35 record (Trading Economics)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 6% and half safe fixed income at about 2.2% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Non-contributory retirement pension (PNC) of EUR 8,803.20 a year in 2026, paid as 14 payments of EUR 628.80 (European Commission guide, July 2026); the value shown is the yearly amount divided by 12. Means-tested.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Spain (July 2026)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 65 or over, living in Spain for 10 years after age 16 including the 2 years before applying, and yearly income below EUR 8,803.20 (household income counted when living with family). Managed by the Autonomous Communities.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Estatuto de los Trabajadores, article 53.1.b (BOE consolidated text)
gratuity_rule.note: Severance on dismissal for objective reasons: 20 days' salary per year of service, capped at 12 months' pay; unfair dismissal pays 33 days per year capped at 24 months (art. 56). There is no statutory payment on normal retirement.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Seguridad Social, ordinary retirement age; pension revaluation 2026
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory Social Security pension (Régimen General), minimum 15 years of contributions. Ordinary age 67 from 2027 (65 with 38 years 6 months of contributions). Contributory pensions were raised 2.7% for 2026 (Seguridad Social revaluation page).

dps.localName: Cuenta individual de ahorro a largo plazo (CIALP)
dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit; long-term savings accounts accept regular contributions.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail-only savings bond; individuals can buy ordinary Letras, Bonos and Obligaciones directly from the Treasury (Tesoro Público).

tbill_91d.note: Sold at regular auctions; individuals can bid directly through the Treasury or through a bank.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold; investment gold is VAT-exempt in the EU.

centralBank.name: Banco de España
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceRegulator.name: Dirección General de Seguros y Fondos de Pensiones (DGSFP)

insuranceComplaints.name: DGSFP, Servicio de Reclamaciones
insuranceComplaints.note: Complain to the insurer's customer service or ombudsman first, then to the DGSFP.

pensionScheme.name: Seguridad Social (Instituto Nacional de la Seguridad Social)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Pensión no contributiva de jubilación (Seguridad Social, revaluation 2026)
oldAgeAllowance.note: Managed and paid by the Autonomous Communities; means-tested.

publicHealthCover.name: Sistema Nacional de Salud (Ministerio de Sanidad)
publicHealthCover.note: Universal public health system run by the Autonomous Communities.

depositInsurance.name: Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos de Entidades de Crédito (FGD)
